data.exact_reserve_text: The result included a release from prior year reserves of GBP 33.6m (2013, GBP 35.3m release). This release is a result of the Markel strategy to reserve prudently together with the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a net release from prior year reserves of GBP 33.6m in 2014 (a release in 2013 of GBP 35.3m). This release is attributed to favourable claims development driven by benign large loss and catastrophe activity during the year and effective claims handling; proactive settlement and reinsurance recovery activity is also noted. No gross prior-year-only movement (insurance-liabilities column) is separately disclosed, so the reported GBP 33.6m is taken from the Managing Agent narrative.
raw_causal_phrases: release from prior year reserves of GBP 33.6m (2013, GBP 35.3m release).
benign large loss and catastrophe activity
dealing with claims in an expeditious manner
the settlement of claims and proactive collection of resinsurance recoveries

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year-only movement (insurance liabilities column) was provided. The Managing Agent narrative states a 'release from prior year reserves of GBP 33.6m' but does not label it gross or net; this figure is therefore treated as a net release (source: Managing Agent report). The Technical Provisions reconciliation shows total gross movements during the year (gross increase of GBP 17.655m) which includes current-year movements and FX and therefore cannot be used as the prior-year-only movement. No claims development triangle was provided to compute gross PYD. Lob-specific reserve movements are not disclosed.
